messages:
jake: Quick pre-release check — planning to publish v1.14.0 tomorrow morning (UTC). Need someone to push an annotated+signed tag, create a GitHub draft release, and confirm artifacts + checksums are uploaded. Leaving a short checklist below.

mina: I can take the tag + create the draft. What should the exact tag message and procedures be?

jake: Tag message: "Release v1.14.0 — runtime + CLI: perf improvements, bugfixes, changelog entries". Steps I recommend:

```
# ensure branch is up to date
git checkout release/v1.14
git pull --ff-only origin release/v1.14

# create an annotated tag
git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "Release v1.14.0 — runtime + CLI: perf improvements, bugfixes"

# (optional) GPG-sign the tag locally
git tag -s v1.14.0 -m "Release v1.14.0"

# push the tag to origin
git push origin v1.14.0
```

Then create a GitHub draft release (gh CLI):
```
# create draft with changelog as notes
gh release create v1.14.0 dist/* --notes-file CHANGELOG.md --draft
```

Artifact steps (build pipeline has produced dist/*):
```
# checksums
shasum -a 256 dist/* > checksums.txt
# upload artifacts to S3
aws s3 cp dist/ s3://redwood-release-bucket/v1.14.0/ --recursive
aws s3 cp checksums.txt s3://redwood-release-bucket/v1.14.0/
```

praveen: Quick security notes: confirm the GPG key you use is the same key uploaded in your GitHub account (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys). We require a signed annotated tag for this release. Also add a manifest.json alongside checksums.txt with SHA256 hashes so downstream teams can verify.

jake: Example minimal manifest schema (we'll add full file in the release assets):
```
{
  "version": "v1.14.0",
  "files": [
    {"name": "redwood-runtime-linux.tar.gz", "sha256": "<hex>"},
    {"name": "redwood-cli-mac.tar.gz", "sha256": "<hex>"}
  ]
}
```

ops-qa: Can we do a quick smoke run after the draft exists but before publishing? I'll run a basic generate+embed test against staging and report back. :eyes:

mina: Plan: I'll push the signed tag and create the draft at 09:00 UTC, then ping here with links. Who will upload the artifacts?

jake: I'll handle artifact upload and checksum generation once the tag is present.

release-bot: Automated reminder: please ensure checksums.txt and manifest.json are included in the draft assets.

mina: Tag pushed and draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.14.0 :rocket: (draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/edit/??)

jake: Uploading artifacts to S3 now and attaching checksums+manifest to the draft.

jake: Done — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-release-bucket/v1.14.0/ and checksums.txt + manifest.json attached to draft. Verified local checksums match S3.

ops-qa: Smoke run results: basic generation, embeddings, and regression tests passed on staging (no obvious regressions).

praveen: Verified GPG signature on tag and validated manifest/checksums. Security LGTM.

mina: If no objections, I'll publish the release at 09:20 UTC. Any last-minute blockers?

jake: No blockers from infra side — approving publish. :tada:

release-bot: Publishing scheduled by mina at 09:20 UTC.

mina: Published. Release URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.14.0 — changelog and assets are attached. Congrats team! :confetti_ball:
